item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President recounts an earlier direction to DHS and subsequent agency action, but this segment imposes no present command or legal consequence.","evidence":"I directed the Secretary of Homeland Security to issue new policy guidance"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"Within 45 days, the Secretary of Homeland Security, coordinating with specified officials, must provide the President a report about agency measures; the required consequence is internal reporting, not a dictated legal outcome.","evidence":"shall submit a report to the President detailing all measures"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"Within 75 days, the Attorney General and Secretary of Homeland Security, after consultation, must report to the President on potentially needed resources or authority; this is an internal review and reporting requirement.","evidence":"shall submit a report to the President identifying any additional resources or authorities"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"Within 60 days, the Secretaries of State and Homeland Security must report on measures and sanctions implementation, while the savings clause preserves existing agency and OMB authority; neither provision itself imposes sanctions or changes legal rights.","evidence":"shall submit a report to the President detailing all measures"}]}
